sloka: विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसा दीनचेतसः।विद्रवन्ति ततः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तचेतसः ।। ६.९८.३७ ।।
transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve rākṣasā dīnacetasaḥ।vidravanti tataḥ sarve bhayavitrastacetasaḥ ।। 6.98.37 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara's head severed and fell on the ground. Seeing that Rakshasa king's army ran from there.
